content.json:
# Zava content-free observability
Select one owning team. Only metadata is queried. Accepted joins are not established calls; native live acceptance, knowledge and Work IQ remain separate gates. Missing data is not a pass.

parameters.name: Team
parameters.query: union requests, dependencies | where timestamp > ago(7d) | extend team=tostring(customDimensions['team.id']) | where isnotempty(team) | distinct team | order by team asc

content.title: Measured hop spans (milliseconds)
content.query: union requests, dependencies | where timestamp {TimeRange} | where tostring(customDimensions['team.id']) == '{Team}' | extend hop=tostring(customDimensions.hop) | where isnotempty(hop) | summarize samples=count(), p50Ms=percentile(duration,50), p95Ms=percentile(duration,95) by hop, cloud_RoleName | order by hop asc

content.title: Join accepted/refused versus connection success; turns, interruptions and approval/refusal counts
content.query: customMetrics | where timestamp {TimeRange} | where tostring(customDimensions['team.id']) == '{Team}' | where name startswith 'zava.scrum.events' | extend event=tostring(customDimensions.event), outcome=tostring(customDimensions.outcome) | summarize count=sum(valueSum) by event, outcome | order by event asc, outcome asc

content.title: Approval chain: a write requires a preceding approved decision in the same session trace
content.query: let hops=dependencies | where timestamp {TimeRange} | where tostring(customDimensions['team.id']) == '{Team}'; let approved=hops | where name == 'approval.decision' and tostring(customDimensions['approval.outcome']) == 'approved' | summarize approvedAt=min(timestamp) by operation_Id; hops | where name == 'ado.write' | join kind=leftouter approved on operation_Id | project timestamp, operation_Id, success, outcome=tostring(customDimensions['write.outcome']), approvedAt, approvalPrecedesWrite=isnotnull(approvedAt) and approvedAt <= timestamp | order by timestamp desc

content.title: Session trace across actual roles and hops
content.query: union requests, dependencies | where timestamp {TimeRange} | where tostring(customDimensions['team.id']) == '{Team}' | where isnotempty(tostring(customDimensions.hop)) | summarize roles=make_set(cloud_RoleName), hops=make_set(name), samples=count() by operation_Id | order by samples desc
